# puff

Minimal deflate decoder by Mark Adler, used to read `.pptx` and `.odp` speaker notes without
depending on Qt private APIs or a system zlib.

- Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib/tree/v1.3.1/contrib/puff (version 2.3, 21 Jan 2013)
- SHA-256 `puff.c`: `5b9d75aeb5baf3575415bc6ade3f2a02e50b6b971b3f8b4fda2b03543bc6e52f`
- SHA-256 `puff.h`: `969b7be2a930db0cdcb19b0e5b29ae6741f5a8f663b6dba6d647e12ec60cfa8e`
- License: zlib (see the notice at the top of `puff.h`). Unmodified.
